name: Anantara Palais Hansen Vienna
positioning: Neo-Renaissance palais hotel by architect Theophil Hansen, on Vienna's Ringstrasse
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palais base on the Ringstrasse within walking distance of museums and theatres
Guests who want suites with separate areas to work and relax
Travelers bringing a pet, with prior reservation

facts.text: The hotel was built by Vienna architect Baron Theophil Edvard von Hansen.
The building is in the Neo-Renaissance style.
The hotel is on the Ringstrasse, with the city's leading museums, theatres and coffeehouses within walking distance.
The hotel is a 15-minute walk from Stephansplatz.
The hotel is 150 metres from the tram and 250 metres from the U-Bahn.
The hotel is a 25-minute drive from Vienna International Airport.
Rooms blend timeless Viennese elegance with contemporary residential flair.
Some room categories have an optional French balcony.
Theo's Lounge & Bar serves Theo's Afternoon Tea.
The hotel offers a discovery experience themed on architectural wonders crafted by a master.
Pets are welcome with prior reservation.

highlights.text: Wellness facilities include a spa, an indoor hydropool and a gym.
Rooms have street views or inner courtyard views.
Suites have separate areas to work, relax and repose.

considerations.text: Parking is in a public garage under the hotel, with lift access directly to the lobby; a daily fee applies.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
